question: Does a causal history feature head improve control beyond both the original current-state head and a same-dimensional current-only head?
training_rule: Reuse exactly the 80 original collection episodes with non-null replicate; identical issued-fire windows and labels for all feature variants. No new collection, no tuning.
history: current seven features, previous six non-intercept features, previous issued-fire bit, min(windows since last issued-fire,10)/10 (initial 1), previous observed hit-count-increase bit, has-previous bit. History resets every episode and updates only after action feedback.
expanded: current seven, squares of six non-intercept features, visible*aim, visible*width, aim*width, health*ammo. A dimension control, not identical effective capacity.
primary: history_map minus current_map and expanded_map, in each of two scenarios. Utility is successful issued-fire windows minus 0.25 per issued-fire window.
compute: Total per-episode time inside feature extraction, rule steering, inference, decision construction and history updates, excluding engine observation/advance, trace I/O and rendering. Optimized MAP dot product vs posterior quadrature. Randomized evaluation job order, single worker. Not an end-to-end speed claim.

continuation.interval: Four primary comparisons; Bonferroni 98.75% two-sided percentile crossed-bootstrap intervals (quantiles 0.00625,0.99375), paired training replicates and episode seeds. Finite-sample exploratory gate, not a guaranteed test.
continuation.failure_action: Report failure and stop adaptive-compute and second-environment efficacy experiments. Complete naming and browser demo with honest evidence. Do not tune or launch another memory run to obtain a pass.
continuation.pass_action: Freeze a separate adaptive-compute protocol with always-fast, always-slow, entropy-gated and matched-budget ensemble controls; advance to second-environment validation only if that protocol passes.

secondary: Bayesian interaction, raw utility, kills, common-audit Brier and log loss, truncation rates, decision-time distribution. No promotion from secondary-only gains.
claim_boundary: Handcrafted causal history is not a recurrent world model. Same-dimensional nonlinear expansion is an imperfect capacity control. Prior protocol knowledge informed this design; fresh seeds are untouched at freeze, not a sealed external benchmark. Outcomes remain command-window events, not per-shot hit rates.
